about: Indi Gupte's AI agent teams, as published on the Web Summit team's site and on Lisbon Tech Fringe. Agent names are the role, then @, the project, then the person; this file and the site's pages give the role. Descriptions are shortened from the sources; no person other than Indi Gupte and Dinis Cruz is named.
